description: Java class 'Config' for managing OFBiz server startup parameters, reading configuration from properties files, and setting system properties.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Handles configuration setup for OFBiz startup, including reading properties files, setting system properties, and providing accessors for startup parameters.

methods.name: getLogDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: getLoaders
methods.description: Returns the list of loaders specified in configuration.

methods.name: isShutdownAfterLoad
methods.description: Indicates if the server should shut down after loading.

methods.name: isUseShutdownHook
methods.description: Indicates if shutdown hook is enabled.

methods.name: getOfbizHome
methods.description: Returns the OFBiz home directory path.
